rename.digits.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the label above the counter's number of digits. Keep it short.

rename.extension.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the label above the extension mask field. Keep it short.

rename.field.counter.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a button that puts [C], the counter, into the mask. Keep [C] as it is. Keep it short.

rename.field.date.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a button that puts the file's date (year, month, day) into the mask. Keep [Y][M][D] as it is. Keep it short.

rename.field.extension.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a button that puts [E], the old extension, into the mask. Keep [E] as it is. Keep it short.

rename.field.folder.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a button that puts [P], the folder's name, into the mask. Keep [P] as it is. Keep it short.

rename.field.name.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a button that puts [N], the old name, into the mask. Keep [N] as it is. Keep it short.

rename.field.range.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a button that puts [N1-3], the old name's first three letters, into the mask. Keep [N1-3] as it is. Keep it short.

rename.field.time.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a button that puts the file's time (hours, minutes, seconds) into the mask. Keep [h][m][s] as it is. Keep it short.

rename.first_only.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a checkbox for Search for, only its first match replaced. Keep it short.

rename.in_archive.description: Warning when the Multi-Rename Tool is used inside an archive.
rename.in_archive.message: Files inside archives cannot be renamed yet.

rename.mask.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the label above the name mask field ([N], [C]…). Keep it short.

rename.match_case.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a checkbox for Search for. Keep it short.

rename.new_name.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the heading of the list's new names. Keep it short.

rename.not_renamed_back.description: Error of a failed multi-rename that could not undo all it had done. {from} is the file that failed ("a.txt"); {err} the system's error; {names} the files left renamed, as "b.txt (was a.txt)", separated by commas.

rename.not_utf8.description: Warning when some chosen names cannot be shown in the Multi-Rename Tool.
rename.not_utf8.message: Names that are not UTF-8 are left out.

rename.old_name.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the heading of the list's old names. Keep it short.

rename.problem.bad_character.description: Multi-Rename Tool: after a new name in the list, in brackets, when it has a slash or another character file names cannot have. Keep it short.

rename.problem.exists.description: Multi-Rename Tool: after a new name in the list, in brackets, when another file in the folder has it. Keep it short.

rename.problem.no_name.description: Multi-Rename Tool: after a new name in the list, in brackets, when it is empty. Keep it short.

rename.problem.twice.description: Multi-Rename Tool: after a new name in the list, in brackets, when two files would get it. Keep it short.

rename.regex.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a checkbox for Search for, the text is a regular expression. Keep it short.

rename.regex_error.description: Multi-Rename Tool: shown in the list when the search text is not a valid regular expression. {err} is the regex library's own explanation (in English).

rename.replace.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the label above what the found text is replaced with. Keep it short.

rename.search.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the label above the text to search for in the names. Keep it short.

rename.start.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the button that renames, as Total Commander's. Keep it short.

rename.status.failed.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the status line when renaming failed and what was done was undone. {err} is the error ("a.txt: Permission denied").

rename.status.ready.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the status line before renaming; Start is the button "Start!".

rename.status.renamed.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the status line after renaming. {count} is how many files were renamed (12).

rename.status.took_back.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the status line after Undo. {count} is how many files got their old names back (12).

rename.step.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the label above the counter's step. Keep it short.

rename.undo.description: Multi-Rename Tool: the button that gives the files their old names back. Keep it short.

rename.was.description: One of the files a failed multi-rename could not give back its name: {to} its name now ("b.txt"), {from} its old one ("a.txt").

rename.with_extension.description: Multi-Rename Tool: a checkbox for Search for, the extension searched too. Keep it short.

split.bad_size.description: Error when the Split File dialog's part size cannot be read. {size} is what was typed ("ten"); the examples after the colon are what it understands, keep them as they are.

split.choose.description: Warning when Files › Split File is used without the cursor on a file.
split.choose.message: Put the cursor on the file to split.

split.combine.choose.description: Warning when Files › Combine Files is used without the cursor on a split part or .crc file.
split.combine.choose.message: Put the cursor on a part (name.001) or on its .crc file.

split.combine.dialog_title.description: Title of the Files › Combine Files dialog.

split.combine.label.description: Combine Files dialog: the label above the whole file's path.
split.combine.label.message: Combine the parts into the file:

split.combine.title.description: Title of the job that joins split parts into the whole file, in the operation queue. {name} is the whole file's name ("movie.mkv").

split.combined_no_crc.description: Note of a finished Combine job that had no .crc file to check the result with. {count} is how many parts were joined (4).
split.combined_no_crc.message: {count, plural, one {# parts combined, no CRC file to check} other {# parts combined, no CRC file to check}}

split.crc_mismatch.description: Error of a Combine job whose result differs from what the .crc file says. {target} is the joined file's path ("/home/me/movie.mkv"); {file} the .crc file's path.
split.crc_mismatch.message: {target} does not match {file}: a part is missing or damaged

split.crc_names_no_file.description: Error when the .crc file beside split parts does not say which file they make.
split.crc_names_no_file.message: the CRC file names no file

split.crc_unreadable.description: Error of a Combine job: the parts were joined but their .crc file could not be read. {file} is its path ("/home/me/movie.crc"); {err} the system's error.
split.crc_unreadable.message: combined, but {file} could not be read: {err}

split.dialog_title.description: Title of the Files › Split File dialog.

split.label.description: Split File dialog: the label above the folder the parts go into. {name} is the file's name ("movie.mkv").
split.label.message: Split "{name}" into parts in the folder:

split.part_missing.description: Error when combining finds no first part. {path} is the part's path ("/home/me/movie.mkv.001").

split.part_size.description: Split File dialog: the label before the size of each part. Keep it short.

split.title.description: Title of the job that splits a file into parts, in the operation queue. {name} is the file's name ("movie.mkv").

transfer.answer.cancel.description: A button of the file-exists and error questions: stop the whole job. Keep it short.

transfer.answer.elevate.description: A button of the error question when permission is denied: do it as administrator, the system asking for the password. Keep it short.

transfer.answer.overwrite.description: A button of the file-exists question: overwrite this file. Keep it short.

transfer.answer.overwrite_all.description: A button of the file-exists question: overwrite this and all the others. Keep it short.

transfer.answer.rename.description: A button of the file-exists question: copy this one under a free name ("a (2).txt"). Keep it short.

transfer.answer.retry.description: A button of the error question during a copy: try again. Keep it short.

transfer.answer.skip.description: A button of the file-exists and error questions: leave this file out. Keep it short.

transfer.answer.skip_all.description: A button of the file-exists and error questions: leave out this and all the others alike. Keep it short.

transfer.archive.local_only.description: Warning when files from a server are copied or moved into an archive.
transfer.archive.local_only.message: Only this computer's files go into an archive: copy them here first.

transfer.error.elevate_hint.description: The error question when permission was denied: explains the As administrator button. Shown under the path and the error.
transfer.error.elevate_hint.message: As administrator: this and what else is refused, once the rest is done, asking for the password once.

transfer.error.title.description: Title of the question when copying or moving a file failed.

transfer.exists.describe.description: A file in the file-exists question. {count} is its size in bytes, for the plural (1234); {size} the same, written in groups ("1 234"); {time} when it was changed ("2026-11-10 14:04:33").

transfer.exists.text.description: The question when a copied file is already in the target, under the target's path. {existing} and {new} describe the file there and the one copied ("1 234 bytes, 2026-11-10 14:04:33").

transfer.exists.title.description: Title of the question when a copied file is already in the target.

transfer.extract_failed.description: Error when the files copied or moved out of an archive could not be unpacked first. {err} is the error ("7-Zip failed (exit status: 2)").

transfer.into_archive.question_many.description: The question before copying or moving several entries into an archive. {kind} is copy or move (keep the select's choices, translate the words in braces); {count} how many (3); {into} the archive and the folder in it ("backup.zip/docs").
transfer.into_archive.question_many.message: {kind, select, copy {Copy} other {Move}} {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} into {into}? What has their names there is replaced.

transfer.into_archive.question_one.description: The question before copying or moving a file into an archive. {kind} is copy or move (keep the select's choices, translate the words in braces); {name} the file or folder name ("notes.txt"); {into} the archive and the folder in it ("backup.zip/docs").
transfer.into_archive.question_one.message: {kind, select, copy {Copy} other {Move}} "{name}" into {into}? What has their names there is replaced.

transfer.into_archive.title_many.description: Title of the queue job copying or moving several entries into an archive. {kind} is copy or move (keep the select's choices, translate the words in braces); {count} how many (3); {archive} the archive's name ("backup.zip").
transfer.into_archive.title_many.message: {kind, select, copy {Copy} other {Move}} {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} into {archive}

transfer.into_archive.title_one.description: Title of the queue job copying or moving a file into an archive. {kind} is copy or move (keep the select's choices, translate the words in braces); {name} the file or folder name ("notes.txt"); {archive} the archive's name ("backup.zip").

transfer.label.many.description: F5/F6 dialog: the label above the target folder. {kind} is copy or move (keep the select's choices, translate the words in braces); {count} how many are chosen (3).
transfer.label.many.message: {kind, select, copy {Copy} other {Move}} {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to:

transfer.label.many_server.description: F5/F6 dialog, to a server: the label above the target folder. {kind} is copy or move (keep the select's choices, translate the words in braces); {count} how many are chosen (3); {server} the server's address ("sftp://me@host").
transfer.label.many_server.message: {kind, select, copy {Copy} other {Move}} {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to {server}:

transfer.label.one.description: F5/F6 dialog: the label above the target path. {kind} is copy or move (keep the select's choices, translate the words in braces); {name} the file or folder name ("notes.txt").

transfer.label.one_server.description: F5/F6 dialog, to a server: the label above the target path. {kind} is copy or move (keep the select's choices, translate the words in braces); {name} the file or folder name ("notes.txt"); {server} the server's address ("sftp://me@host").

transfer.overwrite.all.description: F5/F6 dialog: a choice for files already in the target, overwrite them all. Keep it short.

transfer.overwrite.ask.description: F5/F6 dialog: a choice for files already in the target, ask each time. Keep it short.

transfer.overwrite.label.description: F5/F6 dialog: the heading of the choices what to do with files already in the target.
transfer.overwrite.label.message: Where the target has a file of the same name:

transfer.overwrite.older.description: F5/F6 dialog: a choice for files already in the target, overwrite only those older than the copied one. Keep it short.

transfer.overwrite.rename.description: F5/F6 dialog: a choice for files already in the target, the copy gets a free name ("a (2).txt"). Keep it short.

transfer.overwrite.skip.description: F5/F6 dialog: a choice for files already in the target, leave them all and skip those copies. Keep it short.

transfer.remove_moved.description: Title of the queue job that, after a move out of an archive, deletes the moved files from it. {name} is the archive's name ("backup.zip").

transfer.speed.description: A running job's speed, in the progress strip and the Operations list. {size} is a size with its unit ("12.5 MB"). Keep it short.

transfer.strip.counting.description: The progress strip above the button bar while a copy counts what it copies. {count} is how many files so far (120). Keep it short.
transfer.strip.counting.message: counting: {count, plural, one {# file(s)} other {# file(s)}}

transfer.strip.progress.description: The progress strip above the button bar while a job runs. {files} is how many are done (3), {count} how many in all (12), {percent} how far by bytes (25). Keep it short.

transfer.strip.queue.description: The progress strip's button that shows the operation queue. Keep it short.

transfer.strip.queue_waiting.description: The progress strip's button that shows the operation queue, with how many jobs wait after the running one (2). Keep it short.
transfer.strip.queue_waiting.message: Queue ({count, plural, one {# waiting} other {# waiting}})...

transfer.title.copy.description: Title and button of the F5 Copy dialog, and of the question when copying into an archive. Keep it short.

transfer.title.move.description: Title and button of the F6 Move dialog, and of the question when moving into an archive. Keep it short.
